source_text.body:
Handle mail, replies and calendar with OpenClaw
A commenter uses OpenClaw to check mail, auto-reply to messages and arrange a batch of tasks in their calendar; another uses it for local smart-home integration.
Done with
OC
OpenClaw
What they did
One commenter said they use OpenClaw via tryopenclaw.io linked to ChatGPT Plus for repeated personal admin: checking mail, auto-replying to messages, and taking a batch of tasks they give it and arranging them in their calendar. Another commenter described a broader family-assistant setup that manages calendars, finds conflicts, controls smart-home devices, and builds private web apps at home.
How it went
The thread presents both as things they are using now, with one nontechnical user calling the mail-and-calendar workflow "kinda cool" and another calling tool-to-tool handoffs the most reliable use. It gives no hard metrics, and a nearby commenter warns that anything needing real judgment still needs a human in the loop.
Worth knowing
The only setup detail given is that the nontechnical user used tryopenclaw.io and connected it to ChatGPT Plus.
Try it yourself
with
OpenClaw
Copy prompt
Check my [email account] each [interval] and summarize what needs my attention. Draft replies to routine messages and put the tasks from this list into my calendar: [list of tasks with rough durations]. Show me the drafts and calendar changes first, and do not send any reply or create any event until I approve.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/openclaw/comments/1ta7294/what_are_you_actually_using_openclaw_for_that
